subject: reasoning
question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will NOT be correct?

+ and ÷

I. 27 ÷ 3 - 18 × 3 + 9 = 24

II. 12 ÷ 8 × 12 + 16 - 7 = 19
solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9a5d564c7283c996bbf983d674506968c42456bafed51ec32d0292e6fb1c012.png] 

I. 27 ÷ 3 - 18 × 3 + 9 = 24

Interchanging the given two signs + and ÷, we get:

⇒ 27 + 3 − 18 × __**3 ÷ 9**__** **= 24

⇒ 27
